responsibility: This file lowers D frontend expression ASTs into GCC tree expressions. Its visitor covers the full range of D expression forms, building trees for arithmetic, calls, aggregates, arrays, delegates, vectors, class literals, temporaries, and special language constructs while preserving D evaluation rules, postblit/destructor requirements, and constant-initializer constraints. It also provides wrappers that attach destructor cleanups or return-value handling around expression lowering when expressions appear in statement or return contexts.
